title: Bean Curious — An Introduction to Specialty Coffee
blurb: A hands-on, beginner-friendly walk through the farm-to-cup journey — roasting, species and processing, plus pour over, French press and AeroPress brewing. Includes a full tasting flight and take-home coffee. Registration open.

title: Kerala Masters Pour Over Championship — Season 2
blurb: Kerala's biggest pour-over battle returns, open to baristas and home brewers. Registration is closed.

title: Beyond the Cup — one roaster, one brewer, one table
blurb: Café Addict's first coffee event in its new space. The morning session is a paid, limited-seat experience with Koyan Althani of Urban Hippie Coffee Roasters (IRC 2026 runner-up) on origin and roasting, and Mohamed Rafeeque of Underblu Specialty Coffee on brewing. The afternoon bar takeover is free to attend, with coffees available to order.

title: Coffee Talk #001 — The Roast–Brew Connection
blurb: Aparna Sankar — coffee roaster, CQI Q Arabica Grader and SCA Licensed Evolved Q Grader — on how roast profiles shape extraction, brewing choices and the flavours in the cup. Sold out.
